title: Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour Expands with 12 New Latin America Dates — Extra Shows in Mexico City, Santiago, Buenos Aires, and San José
detail: During the week of May 12–13, 2026, Live Nation and Rimas Entertainment confirmed 12 additional shows to the Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour in response to record demand across Latin America. The expansion adds six extra Mexico City dates at Estadio GNP Seguros, two more Santiago nights at Estadio Monumental, two more Buenos Aires nights at Estadio Monumental de Núñez (River Plate), and a second San José (Costa Rica) date at Estadio Nacional. The additions extend the tour's already historic Latin American run — which included sold-out residencies across Bogotá, Lima, São Paulo, and Medellín — and underscore the commercial momentum of *Debí Tirar Más Fotos* nineteen months into its release cycle. The DtMF World Tour began November 21, 2025 in Puerto Rico and spans six continents through July 22, 2026 in Brussels, deliberately excluding all U.S. mainland dates as a political statement against ICE immigration enforcement. The European stadium leg opens nine days away at Barcelona's Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys on May 22–23 (sold out), before continuing to Lisbon, Madrid, Düsseldorf, Arnhem, London, Paris, Stockholm, Warsaw, Milan, and Brussels. The tour's stage design — a towering asymmetrical mountain inspired by Puerto Rican landscapes plus a B-stage called 'La Casita' (a recreation of a family home in Humacao) — has been praised as one of the most ambitious concert productions of the decade, reinforcing the album's themes of memory, belonging, and Puerto Rican identity.
